decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX was already well received as BASIC 518 and has strong sunk investments and public commitment, making withdrawal very unlikely under escalation.
Its dedicated product page for a multi-model line signals substantial visible commitment and development costs, so management continues despite any disappointing early results.
Although it has lower public visibility as a niche fine shredder, the sunk engineering costs and management responsibility make persistence likely, but temporary attributions weaken after four years.
This green-waste-specific grinder line fits the announced resource-saving direction, and earlier weak results are still attributed to temporary causes, reinforcing continued commitment.
Its own product page and several models represent significant public commitment and sunk costs, keeping the pre-shredder line in the portfolio.
